blocks.text: Another Filipino reference to the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) has been dropped as boxing icon Manny Pacquiao was mentioned in the third episode of Marvel’s “VisionQuest.” The episode, released on Wednesday, Oct. 21, features Vision, played by Paul Bettany, bringing up the eight-division world champion during a conversation with Tommy Maximoff, portrayed by Ruaridh Mollica. The exchange takes place after Tommy accidentally injures himself while using his powers on a vending machine. When Vision checks on him, Tommy assures him that he will be fine and mentions that he is a southpaw, or a left-handed fighter. With assistance from E.D.I.T.H., played […]...
